# WebView / Console (deployment posture, owner login, branding)

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- POLYROB_POSTURE — default: _derived_ (see below) — Explicit deployment posture override: `local` | `own_ops` | `multitenant` (case-insensitive). **Wins outright** over every other posture signal.
- WEBGATE_HOST / WEBVIEW_HOST — default: _posture-derived_ (127.0.0.1 for local, 0.0.0.0 for own_ops/multitenant) — Explicit bind-host override; also feeds posture derivation (step 1 above) when `POLYROB_POSTURE` is unset — a non-loopback value implies `own_ops`. `WEBGATE_HOST` wins over `WEBVIEW_HOST` when both are set.
- WEBVIEW_ALLOW_LOCAL_POSTURE — default: OFF — Escape hatch for the server-posture boot refusal: at `local` posture (loopback with owner login) the console **refuses to start** when the deployment looks like a server — `WEBVIEW_PUBLIC_URL` set, a `--proxy-headers`/`--forwarded-allow-ip…
- WEBVIEW_EMIT_URL — default: unset — Loopback-only authenticated fast-push, using a token derived from `API_AUTH_TOKEN` or `WEBGATE_JWT_SECRET`; unset credentials use the file watcher.
- WEBGATE_JWT_SECRET — default: unset (secret, masked) — Fallback secret for the loopback telemetry fast-push token when `API_AUTH_TOKEN` is unset (HMAC-derived; the secret itself never travels).
- WEBGATE_PORT / WEBVIEW_PORT — default: 5050 — Bind port. `WEBGATE_PORT` wins over `WEBVIEW_PORT` when both are set. (`server_launcher.py`'s own code-level default is 3000; the production systemd unit sets `WEBVIEW_PORT=5050`, which `webgate.bind_port()` also defaults to.)
- POLYROB_OWNER_USERNAME — default: unset — Owner login username for `own_ops`/`multitenant` posture (Posture 1/2 console access).
- POLYROB_OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH — default: unset — Argon2 hash of the owner password — **never plaintext**. `verify_owner_password` always runs a real argon2 verify (against a precomputed dummy hash when the username doesn't match) so a wrong username can't be distinguished from a wrong pa…
- POLYROB_CONSOLE_NAME — default: "POLYROB Console" — Opt-in override of the web console's product display name.
- POLYROB_SUPPORT_URL — default: unset ("") — Support link shown on the console sign-in page.
- POLYROB_SUPPORT_HANDLE — default: unset ("") — Support handle text shown as the support link's label (falls back to the link itself).
- POLYROB_BRAND_URL — default: unset ("") — Instance brand URL; also the base for the derived `terms_url`/`privacy_url` defaults below.
- POLYROB_ORG_URL — default: unset ("") — Parent-org URL shown in the console footer.
- POLYROB_TERMS_URL — default: {POLYROB_BRAND_URL}/terms, or unset ("") if POLYROB_BRAND_URL is also unset — Terms-of-service link.
- POLYROB_PRIVACY_URL — default: {POLYROB_BRAND_URL}/privacy, or unset ("") if POLYROB_BRAND_URL is also unset — Privacy-policy link (same fix as above).
- WEBVIEW_FEED_DEFAULT_LIMIT — default: 500 — Default number of feed events returned by the console feed endpoints.
- WEBVIEW_FEED_MAX_LIMIT — default: 2000 — Hard cap on a requested feed-event limit.
- WEBVIEW_INSTALL_PREFIX — default: /opt/polyrob — Install prefix whose `logs/` dir the standalone webview launcher writes `webview.log` into.
- WEBVIEW_LOG_LEVEL — default: info — Default `--log-level` for the standalone webview launcher.
- WEBVIEW_VERSION — default: unset (= the installed package version) — Explicit override of the version string the console displays (for deployments that pin it).
- WEBVIEW_WS_URL — default: unset ('' = same-origin) — Explicit Socket.IO endpoint URL handed to the console frontend; unset connects same-origin.
